text:
sam: Heads-up — since ~09:12 UTC we're seeing a rise in OOB IPMI session churn from a subset of racks after the BMC v2.14 rollout in ap-south1. Affected nodes are hitting repeated coredump uploads and the provisioner is evicting GPUs due to management plane flaps.
jess: Ugh. Any evidence it's the new sampler patch?
sam: Correlation is strong: last night we flipped the telemetry sampler to verbose in v2.14 (intended for logging). Edge racks show 3-5x IPMI reconnects/min. Example log snippet from a node: ```kernel: bmc_coredump: start upload id=0x8f3 size=1.2MB
ipmi: session 0x4f lost: connection reset by peer
mgmtd: telemetry: sampler flood detected (samples/sec=1200)```
alex: ops-bot alert also fired: "oob.session.rate > 300/min -> provisioner throttle". Ops-bot, can you paste the alert stream?
ops-bot: ALERT stream: ap-south1/oob-rate: 09:12–09:40 spike to 420 sessions/min (rolling 5m). 73 hosts reported coredump activity. Notifying eng-infra and eng-oncall.
maria: That's the canary pool we pushed last night. We only intended verbose for 10 canaries, not fleetwide. Rollout config shows target=canary but one of the job templates had label mismatch so it hit ~15% of ap-south1 racks.
ira: Impact on capacity: provisioning reports 48 GPUs transiently evicted and 120 queued for retry over the last 30m. Latency on allocation API up from 120ms to 380ms. Cost: autoscaler spun up 4 extra warm nodes to compensate.
jess: Ok we should pause the rollout and rollback that sampler flag ASAP. Who can flip the job?
alex: I'm on it. Plan: 1) Pause fleet rollout in deploy UI (done) 2) Patch canary label to correct selector and redeploy 3) In parallel, issue soft rollback for BMC config to disable verbose sampler on affected racks.
sam: For rollback: we have an automation script -- runbook snippet: ```# run from ops bastion
for rack in $(cat affected-racks.txt); do ssh ops@$rack 'sudo /usr/bin/bmc-config set telemetry.sampler.verbose=false && systemctl restart mgmtd'; done```
ira: Can we avoid sshing all racks? That caused some parallelness issues earlier. Use the management plane batch API with rate-limit 10/s: ```curl -s -X POST https://mgmt.api.local/batch/config?rate=10 -d @disable-sampler.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN"```
ops-bot: Rollout paused by alex at 09:46 UTC. Runbook executed: batch job queued (job_id=job_2026_09_46_01). 43/73 hosts patched so far, 00:12 elapsed.
jess: Good. Postmortem items: - tighten canary selector tests - add limit on telemetry samples/sec within BMC image - add preflight that checks intended target count before rollout
maria: Also let's add an emergency fallback to temporarily divert management traffic to secondary OOB gateways in the region to smooth session spikes. That avoids immediate evictions.
sam: Agreed. Temporary mitigation: update routing table to add oob-secondary.ap-south1.local for the canary racks (ops-network will coordinate).
ira: Monitoring checks to add: OOB session churn >100/min triggers pre-emptive sampler throttle, and coredump upload rate >50/h triggers automatic verbose=false toggle.
alex: I'll keep the rollout paused until we confirm stable OOB session rates for 1h after finishing patch. Next update in 15m. :hourglass: 
ops-bot: job_id=job_2026_09_46_01 completed at 10:05 UTC. Patched 73 hosts, 0 failures. Observed sessions/min back to baseline (~35). Provisioner drain/evict rate returned to normal.
jess: Excellent. Thanks everyone. We'll file a short incident blameless postmortem and schedule the selector fix before next release window. :thumbsup:
